verdict.rationale: AMD's official spec sheet documents 288GB HBM3E memory and 8TB/s bandwidth, far exceeding what a 70B-class quantized model requires (even at FP16, ~140GB), making single-node/local inference clearly practical, and this is corroborated by independent community analysis confirming the capacity/bandwidth figures and vLLM/SGLang inference support docs. missing for 10: no direct hands-on benchmark of a 70B model specifically at various quantization levels on MI355X, and some independent throughput comparisons (vs Nvidia B300) suggest AMD trails on decode tok/s per stream, which slightly tempers real-world inference-speed confidence.
